## Alis — Reactive

### ComponentRef<T>

Authoring handle for a plan-registered component target. Native and Fusion
extension methods consume it to declare component property sets, method calls,
and value reads in the Reactive Plan.

### IAppLevelComponent

Represents a layout-owned component that can be referenced without an explicit element ID.


### Plugin

Declares a Reactive Plan plugin: a named runtime object the DSL does not model,
exposing typed readable properties, value-returning functions, and commands
with no return value. A plugin is the intentional escape hatch for runtime behavior
that does not need a first-class deterministic DSL primitive. Subclass it,
name the plugin in the base constructor, and declare members in the body.

```csharp
// Properties
Name { get; }  // Plugin registration name resolved by the runtime.
```

```csharp
Command(member)
Command(member, arguments)
Command()
Command(arguments)
Function<T>(member)
Function<T>(member, arguments)
Function<T>()
Function<T>(arguments)
Property<T>(member)
```

### PluginCommand

```csharp
Args(arguments)
```

### PluginFunction<T>

## Builders — Arrays

### ReactiveArray<T>

A typed, deferred array transform. Operators capture authoring intent as
Reactive Plan `array-op` nodes; they do not execute on the server. Deliberately not
`IEnumerable`/`IQueryable`, so LINQ extension methods
are not candidates (no collision) and lambdas are captured, not invoked. Per-element
predicates and selectors read the element scope; chains compose as plan nodes.

```csharp
All(predicate)
Any()
Any(predicate)
AsSource()
Count()
Count(predicate)
Find(predicate)
Find<T>(predicate, selector)
OrderBy<T>(key)
OrderByDescending<T>(key)
Select<T>(selector)
Sum(Expression<Func<TElement, int>> selector)
Sum(Expression<Func<TElement, decimal>> selector)
Sum(Expression<Func<TElement, double>> selector)
Where(predicate)
```

### ReactiveValue<T>

A scalar value produced by an array operation, such as `Count` or `Sum`.
It is a `TypedSource<T>`, so it can feed DSL members that read typed
sources, including `SetText`, `When`, and dispatch payloads.
Gather intake remains limited to component and plugin sources.

A typed source whose runtime value is read from the browser `window.location` query string.

## Serialization

### PlanNodeDiscriminator<T>

Serializes a polymorphic plan node by writing its concrete runtime type's properties, so the
node's own `Kind` property becomes the JSON discriminator. The single discriminator
mechanism for every plan node family; reading is unsupported because plans are write-only.

```csharp
Read(reader, typeToConvert, options)
Write(writer, value, options)
```

## Validation

### ClientValidationCondition<T>

Completed client validation condition that can be composed.

### ClientValidationConditionBuilder<T>

Builds typed field conditions for client validation rules.

### ClientValidationField

Describes a single field's validation rules within a form.
The rule source declares the field path and shape before render-time binding.

### ClientValidationFieldConditionStart<T>

Starts a client validation condition from a typed model field.

### ClientValidationFieldRuleBuilder<T>

Writes rules for one client validation field.

### ClientValidationFieldToken<T>

Opaque typed reference to a model field used by client validation rules.

### ClientValidationRulesBuilder<T>

Builds one model's deterministic client validation rules.

### IClientValidationRuleSource

Provides deterministic client validation rules for a validation source type.

### ReactiveClientValidationBuilder

Registers app-level client validation metadata keyed by validation source type.

### ReactiveClientValidationServiceCollectionExtensions

Registers explicit client validation metadata for Reactive Plans.

### FusionGridValidation

Emits Syncfusion-native column `validationRules` from the same`ReactiveValidator` client metadata that powers form validation, so a Grid's
in-cell editor validates client-side without a second hand-written ruleset. The
validation source stays single (the validator), and EJ2's own `FormValidator`
runs the rule on cell save.


### FusionScheduleActionCompleteArgs

Event payload delivered after Syncfusion Schedule completes an action successfully.

```csharp
// Properties
RequestType { get; }  // Syncfusion action name that completed, for example `eventChange` or `viewNavigate`.
```

Wraps rendered Syncfusion schedule markup while carrying plan metadata for `.Reactive(...)` chaining.

Event payload delivered when a Syncfusion Schedule time cell is clicked.
Includes the selected slot and resource group.

```csharp
// Properties
EndTime { get; }  // End time of the clicked cell slot.
GroupIndex { get; }  // Zero-based index of the resource group (e.g., which shift).
IsAllDay { get; }  // True if the all-day row was clicked.
StartTime { get; }  // Start time of the clicked cell slot.
```

### FusionScheduleDataBoundArgs

Notification payload delivered after Syncfusion Schedule data has loaded and rendered.
Use to hide loaders or update counts after server data loads.

### FusionScheduleEventClickArgs

Event payload delivered when a Syncfusion Schedule appointment is clicked.

```csharp
// Properties
Cancel { get; }  // Set to true before the callback returns to prevent the default quick-info popup.
```

### FusionScheduleEventData

Schedule event data projected from Syncfusion event records and `getEvents()`.

```csharp
// Properties
CategoryColor { get; }  // Optional color used by Syncfusion when rendering the appointment.
Id { get; }  // Schedule event identifier.
IsUnassigned { get; }  // Whether the appointment currently has no assigned staff member.
ShiftId { get; }  // Resource or group identifier for the shift.
StaffName { get; }  // Assigned staff member name when available.
StaffRole { get; }  // Assigned staff member role when available.
Subject { get; }  // Display title for the appointment.
```

### FusionScheduleEventRenderedArgs

Event payload delivered before Syncfusion Schedule renders an appointment.
Use `Data` for conditional styling. Set `Cancel`
to prevent the appointment from rendering.

```csharp
// Properties
Cancel { get; }  // Set to true before the callback returns to prevent this appointment from rendering.
Data { get; }  // Schedule event data being rendered. Use in conditions for conditional styling.
Type { get; }  // Syncfusion render type, for example `event`.
```

### FusionScheduleEvents

Typed events exposed by the `FusionSchedule` component.

```csharp
// Properties
ActionBegin { get; }  // Fires before a scheduler action begins. Use `RequestType` to distinguish `eventCreate`, `eventChange`, etc.
ActionComplete { get; }  // Fires after a scheduler action completes. Use `RequestType` to identify the completed action.
CellClicked { get; }  // Fires when a time cell is clicked. Includes start/end time, group index, and all-day state.
DataBound { get; }  // Fires after data is loaded and rendered.
EventClicked { get; }  // Fires when an event/appointment is clicked.
EventRendered { get; }  // Fires before each event renders. Used for custom styling (e.g., unassigned shifts in red). Cancelable.
Navigating { get; }  // Fires before date or view navigation. Use `Action` to distinguish `date` and `view` navigation. Cancelable.
PopupClose { get; }  // Fires when a popup closes.
PopupOpen { get; }  // Fires before a popup opens. Use `Type` to distinguish `QuickInfo`, `Editor`, etc. Cancelable.
```
